5/13/2014Enacted by Chapter 356, 2014 General Session2014Definitions.As used in this part: "Ballot proposition" means: an opinion question or other question concerning a tax increase submitted to voters for their approval or rejection; or a question submitted to voters concerning the issuance of bonds under Section 11-14-103. "Ballot proposition" does not include an initiative or referendum authorized under Title 20A, Chapter 7, Issues Submitted to the Voters. "Determination date" means the date of an election at which a ballot proposition is considered by voters. "Election officer" is as defined in Section 20A-1-102. "Eligible voter" means a person who:
has registered to vote in accordance with Title 20A, Chapter 2, Voter Registration; and is a resident of a voting district or precinct within the taxing entity that is holding an election to consider a ballot proposition. "Governing body" is as defined in Section 59-2-102. "Tax increase" means:
for a property tax, the imposition of a property tax rate or increase in a property tax rate if the imposition or increase is required to be submitted to voters for their approval or rejection; or for a sales and use tax imposed under Chapter 12, Sales and Use Tax Act, a sales and use tax rate that: is not currently imposed; or exceeds the sales and use tax rate that is currently imposed. "Taxing entity" means:
a taxing entity as defined in Section 59-2-102; or a county, city, or town authorized to impose a sales and use tax under Chapter 12, Sales and Use Tax Act.
